writes RemovedBy and RemovalReason to output chunks (859, 873), but their entity has neither field (492). GetHvRequestQuery's lastOutput and StreamHvRunOutputQuery still decompress removed payloads without a removed-evidence outcome (753, 880-893), unlike FR-MCP-HVPIPE-019-AC004. Define the retained fields and post-removal behavior on every payload-reading surface, with named cases."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F17",
      "Status": "FAIL",
      "Title": "VI-05 understates the possible append rate",
      "Classification": "implementer edit",
      "Location": [
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1395",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2500",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC002"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "VI-05's asserted maximum of 14400 appends per run hour (2500) is false under R-12 and the byte-triggered flush (1395): multiple OutputFlushBytes batches can arrive within one interval. State a valid measurement workload and account for byte-triggered writes and audit overhead; do not call this an interval-imposed bound."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F18",
      "Status": "FAIL",
      "Title": "The artifact-worker repair has no contract for its existing requirements",
      "Classification": "implementer edit",
      "Location": [
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:167",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1372",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2486",
        "PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001/H3",
        "FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002/acceptanceCriteria[3]",
        "FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003/acceptanceCriteria[3]"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "H3 promises P1 to P3 fixed using HvWorkerHost (167, 2486), but the host and claim/failure/finalization contracts only service HvRequest. The live FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 AC4 separately requires configured/default AgentPool behavior, distinct request/attempt/pool-job/model-execution/accepted-result identities, internal-only cancellation and one accepted terminal result. FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 AC4 prohibits raw artifact/prompt storage, unlike turn HV's complete brief log. No artifact queue adapter, units, identity mapping, retention boundary, or tests integrate these unchanged requirements. Define that separate-context contract and its H0 mocks/H3 production cases before approval, sharing only compatible execution primitives."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F19",
      "Status": "FAIL",
      "Title": "Abrupt worker death has no guaranteed reviewer-process cleanup",
      "Classification": "implementer edit",
      "Location": [
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:298",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1444",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1870",
        "src/QBrainAi.Common.AgentCli/DefaultProcessSpawner.cs:12",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-007-AC003",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC011"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "W-03 and sequence 17.7 assume the reviewer process is gone when the worker crashes (298, 1870). The reused IProcessSpawner starts an ordinary process and provides explicit Kill only (DefaultProcessSpawner.cs:12-16,48-51). A killed worker cannot call Kill or observe stale_fence; lease expiry fences database writes but does not stop its child. No owner-death containment or recovery outcome is specified. Define and test abrupt worker death with a surviving reviewer and descendants, without imposing a review deadline."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F20",
      "Status": "FAIL",
      "Title": "Plugin idempotency keys exceed their limit and omit invocation identity",
      "Classification": "implementer edit",
      "Location": [
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:453",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:471",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1453",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-005-AC005",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-020"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "The plugin idempotency key embeds the full requestId plus a fixed 20-character prefix/suffix overhead (1453), but requestId may be 256 and IdempotencyKey only 128 (453, 471). A valid requestId above 108 characters produces an invalid key. It also omits the full submitting session identity and contextFormat, although the payload fingerprint includes them. Define a bounded canonical key over the full invocation identity and test maximum-length and cross-session calls."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F21",
      "Status": "FAIL",
      "Title": "A late verification failure can undo successful finalization",
      "Classification": "implementer edit",
      "Location": [
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:338",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1045",
        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1100",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-010",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-012"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "A late verification failure can overwrite successful finalization. FailHvRunCommand accepts null WorkerId and the released stored fence (1045), checks only FencedLease, and writes Failed plus request retry state (1046). Finalize may commit Succeeded/Completed first (1100) without changing that released fence. Unlike finalization, Fail does not re-check OutputClosed/Finalizing and versions in it
